messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a slowroll for v2 in APAC tomorrow during the 02:00-06:00 UTC window. Need a quick checklist: client compat FAQ, release notes blurb, and rollback criteria.
sam: +1. What's the canary slice and telemetry we want to watch?
maria: Canary = 1% of traffic per region for first hour, then 5% for 2 hours if green. Watch 5xx rate, tail latency (p95/p99), and schema errors from SDKs.
liam: For p99 we want <1200ms. If p99 > 2s or 5xx delta > 0.5% need operator alert and consider pause.
jess: Docs: I'll update release-notes/v2.md and add a client migration FAQ. Can we include example error responses so SDK teams can map them?
maria: yes. Add snippet for header negotiation and how clients can pin to v1 via `X-API-Version: 1`.
tasha: Ops: prepare rollback runbook. If we hit threshold, what's the deploy-bot command to pause and rollback?
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @maria for 2027-05-04T02:15:00Z. To pause: `/deploy pause v2-rollout --tag canary`.
ops-bot: To rollback canary slice run: `/deploy rollback v2-rollout --to-tag v1-stable --slice all` (ops approval required).
sam: We should also set automatic fallback routing after 3 consecutive probe failures for a tenant. Does the router support per-tenant stickiness back to v1?
liam: yes, router has sticky pinning. We'll add a 30m backoff and auto-pin TTL of 24h for affected tenants.
jess: Release note blurb (draft): "v2: improved streaming and reduced token cost. Breaking change: tokenization of legacy `chat.v1` responses — clients should prefer the v2-compatible SDKs or pin to v1 via header." Thoughts?
maria: wording fine. Add explicit migration steps and code example lines for SDKs.
tasha: Telemetry hooks: set an Ops eyes dashboard for the rollout with these panels: p95, p99, 5xx rate, error-class by tenant, and deploybot events in last hour.
sam: Also enable the regression-alert rule at a low sensitivity for first 6 hours.
liam: I'll push a quantized model variant to dedicated pools as fallback in case v2 microbench fails; routing can auto-failover to that variant.
maria: Final ops checklist: docs updated by jess, rollback runbook by tasha, deploybot schedule /pause command tested by sam, telemetry dashboards live by liam. We'll publish a short note to customers in the morning.
jess: I'll queue the release-note PR and tag docs-review. ETA 3h.
sam: I will run a dry-run of `/deploy pause` in staging now.
deploy-bot: staging pause simulation: SUCCESS — command executed in staging at 6215554400.
sam: Verified pause command and rollback note in runbook. Everything green from staging side.
tasha: Ops will be on-call during the window. I posted shift details in #eng-oncall.
maria: Great — unless any objections, we proceed with the slowroll tomorrow. :thumbsup:
liam: No objections from me.
jess: :shipit:
maria: locking this thread. If anything changes ping @tasha and @sam.
